easy.def: A circle of twelve star signs.
examples: Leo is in the zodiac.
The zodiac has twelve signs.
My sign is in the zodiac.

more.def: A group of twelve star signs that people use in astrology.
examples: Leo is one of the twelve signs of the zodiac.
The zodiac is shown on a wheel.
Each month has a sign from the zodiac.

easy.def: A pretend monster in scary stories.
examples: The zombie is pretend.
He dressed as a zombie.
I saw a zombie costume.

more.def: A make-believe creature in scary stories that is said to walk although it is dead.
examples: He dressed as a zombie for Halloween.
The zombie in the movie was pretend.
The kids wore zombie masks to the party.

easy.def: A place set apart for one thing.
examples: Cars go slow in a school zone.
This is a no-running zone.
The ball went into the end zone.

more.def: An area that is set apart for a special use or that differs from the areas around it.
examples: There is a quiet zone in the library for reading.
The city made a car-free zone in the center.
Hard hats must be worn in the building zone.

easy.def: A place where you go to see wild animals.
examples: We went to the zoo.
The zoo has lions.
I saw monkeys at the zoo.

more.def: A park where wild animals are kept so people can see and learn about them.
examples: We saw giraffes and lions at the zoo.
The zoo has a new baby panda.
Our class went to the zoo on a field trip.

easy.def: A person who takes care of zoo animals.
examples: The zookeeper fed the seals.
A zookeeper feeds animals.
The zookeeper is kind.

more.def: A person whose job is to look after animals in a zoo.
examples: The zookeeper fed the lions.
A zookeeper cleans the cages.
The zookeeper told us about the monkeys.
She studies zoology.
Zoology is about animals.
He likes zoology.

more.def: The scientific study of animals and how they live.
examples: She studies zoology at school.
Zoology teaches us about wildlife.
He wants to work in zoology.
The race car will zoom by.
The bee zooms by my ear.
A jet zoomed over us.

more.def: To move very quickly, often with a humming sound.
examples: The bikes zoomed down the hill.
The skaters zoomed around the rink.
A motorcycle zoomed past us on the highway.
